pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with discernible edge boundaries. Spatial area is largest on the upper mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pathways forming tri-radial and quad-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the primary flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck and shoulder ridge, appearing as a dark, textured fringe against the background.
